mil7.3.10:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, samuddassa pañca angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni pañca angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.3.10:1.2: Yathā mahārāja mahāsamuddo matena kunapena saddhiṃ na saṃvasati,
mil7.3.10:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-makkha-paḷāsa-issā-macchariya-māyā-saṭha-kuṭila-visamaduccarita-kilesa malehi saddhiṃ na saṃvasitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.10:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja samuddassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.10:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja samuddo muttā-maṇi-veḷuriya-sankhasilā-pavāḷa-phaḷikamaṇi-vivharatana-nicayaṃ dhārento pidahati, na bahi vikirati,
mil7.3.10:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena magga-phala-jhāna-vimokhasamādhi-samāpatti-vipassanā-'bhiññā-vividhaguṇaratanān; adhigantvā pidahitabbāni, na bahi nīharitabbāni.
mil7.3.10:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja samuddassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.10:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja samuddo mahatimahābhūtehi saddhiṃ saṃvasati,
mil7.3.10:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarenā appicchaṃ santuṭṭhaṃ dhutavādaṃ sallekhavuttiṃ ācārasampannaṃ lajjiṃ pesalaṃ garuṃ bhāvaniyaṃ vattāraṃ vacanakkhamaṃ codakaṃ pāpagarahiṃ ovādakaṃ anusāsakaṃ viññāpakaṃ sandassakaṃ samādapakaṃ samuttejakaṃ sampahaṃsakaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ upanissāya vasitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.10:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja samuddassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.10:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja samuddo navasalila-sampuṇṇa-Gangā-Yamunā-AciravatīSarabhū-Mahī-ādīhi nadīsatasahassehi antalikkhe saliladhārāhi ca pūrito pi sakaṃ velaṃ nātivattati,
mil7.3.10:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena lābha-sakkāra-silokavandana-mānana-pūjanakāraṇā jīvitahetu pi sañcicca sikkhāpadavītikkamo na karaṇīyo.
mil7.3.10:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja samuddassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.10:5.1: Seyyathā pi mahārāja mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātikkamati,
mil7.3.10:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yaṃ mayā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ taṃ mama sāvakā jīvitahetu pi nātikkamantīti.
mil7.3.10:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja samuddo sabbasavantīhi GangāYamunā-Aciravatī-Sarabhū-Mahīhi antalikkhe udakadhārāhi pi na paripūrati,
mil7.3.10:6.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena uddesa-paripucchā-savana-dhāraṇa-vinicchaya-abhidhamma-vinaya-gāḷha-suttanta-viggaha-padanikkhepa-padasandhi-padavibhatti-navanga-jinasāsanavaraṃ suṇantenāpi na tappitabbaṃ.
mil7.3.10:6.3: Idaṃ mahārāja samuddassa pañcamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.10:6.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Sutasomajātake:
mil7.3.10:7.4: sutvā na tappanti subhāsitenāti. Uddānaṃ: Lāpūlatā
